question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**policies**" refers to a set of ideas or a plan of what to do in particular situations, agreed to officially by a group of people, a business organization, a government, or a political party. (नीतियाँ)
 
• In this context, company "**policies**" means the rules and guidelines set by the company for its employees to follow.
 
• The other options: "**sets**," "**divisions**," and "**types**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When you start a new job, you want to make a good impression on your colleagues and supervisors. Behaving professionally, being punctual, and following company **policies**__ and procedures can help you establish a positive reputation in the workplace.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sets (सेट्स)**: means a collection of objects or numbers. It is not suitable in this context.
 
• **Divisions (प्रभाग)**: means the action of separating something into parts or the process of being separated. It is not appropriate here.
 
• **Types (प्रकार)**: means a category of people or things having common characteristics. It is not appropriate here.
